title: Pooppoopers Music Discs Volume 1.
description: Makes the music discs in Minecraft MUCH better
body: Replaces the default Minecraft music discs with music made by the [Poopshitters](https://www.youtube.com/@thepoopshitterss), be sure to check them out. We have no affiliation with the [Poopshitters](https://www.youtube.com/@thepoopshitterss)  we are just huge fans of their music. ### Music Replaced: 5 - [Album 1 Song 5](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fq20n1OWfuY) 11 - [Album 3 Song 8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w0Sxn5GRMbg) 13 - [Album 1 Song 8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jqs-2fIl7w4) Blocks - [Album 2 Song 10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBgrjppVDvA) Cat - [Album 2 Song 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K31GjhkEJ8Y) Chirp - [Album 3 Song 5](https://youtu.be/Gn1er5rRdqo) Creator - [Album 1 Song 1 (Extended)](https://youtu.be/cDPaFQXKyxY) Creator Music Box - [Album 1 Song 1](https://youtu.be/5J-nC2FBgM0) Far - [Album 1 Song 2](https://youtu.be/8z2CjanT-Wo) Mall - [Album 3 Song 9](https://youtu.be/osZo4wVkGRs) Mellohi - [Album 1 Song 6](https://youtu.be/2Rlz1Ua27Ic) Otherside - [Album 4 Song 7](https://youtu.be/LgO2CKoS9eE) Pigstep - [Album 5 Song 4](https://youtu.be/a3ClB4JQ3yQ) Precipice - [Album 3 Song 7](https://youtu.be/prdvoMpLzcM) Relic - [Album 4 Song 5](https://youtu.be/Ei2AWddJSmE) Stal - [Album 3 Song 2](https://youtu.be/kKDHNtMes9I) Strad - [Album 1 Song 10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u090aES9ceg) Wait - [Album 3 Song 4](https://youtu.be/e5lrPmG2ZnE) Ward - [Album 4 Song 2](https://youtu.be/B9lFZot2UBo) ### V1.1 Update Lava Chicken - [Album 5 Song 10](https://youtu.be/F7Vrxy2qtEo) Tears - [Album 5 Song 9](https://youtu.be/xoxWWwFOqKE)
